title: Quarterly family meeting
logline: Dad runs breakfast like a corporate meeting to find out who ate the last biscuit; his kid out-corporates him.
pov: POV: your dad just read a management book
description: Every family needs a quarterly review. Apparently.

lines.text: Okay, family. Welcome to our first quarterly family meeting.
Dad, it's breakfast. And it's just us.
Agenda item one. Someone ate the last biscuit.
The dog doesn't have opposable thumbs.
Which is why he needed my help.
Wait. So you're admitting you took it?
I'm saying it was cross-team collaboration.
Thanks. Now let's discuss my bonus.
